entities.summary: Katarzyna Gajgał-Anioł is a Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 2003–14 and Polish club KPS Chemik Police, a participant of the Olympic Games Beijing 2008, bronze medalist of European Championship 2009, four-time Polish Champion.
